entities.summary: Wari Empire, a political institution in Peru during Regional Kingdoms: Nazca, Moche, Wari, and Chimú (600–1438). Grew from Chan Chan built — largest adobe city in the world, Chimú capital and Wari Empire establishes first Andean road and administrative network. Led to the emergence of Andean and Discovery of Lord of Sipán's tomb — 1987, 'King Tut of the Americas'.
